lines.en: Please don't ever leave me like that again, Sybil...
lines.zh: 请不要再这样离开我了，茜比尔……

lines.en: What am I going to do with you, Sybil...
lines.zh: 我该拿你怎么办呢，茜比尔……

lines.en: ...Thank you for looking out for me, Protagonist.
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en:
Sybil, let me tell you about what it means to be a Paladin.  We are not brutes, nor do we desire for ourselves.  A Paladin has been forged in the fire of battle for most of their lives, and is punished harshly for pursuing worldly reward, or succumbing to fear.  We must be ready to die for Donar.
Even though evil forces have nearly destroyed us, the Paladins will live on.  Under normal circumstances, you as a female must have bore a child to a father of the Temple's choosing.  But we are living in extraordinary times, and our sacred order needs you.
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Should you become a Sister of Justice, your sole purpose will be as a divine weapon of war, and you will wield the essence of divinity as your armor and weapon.  With this power comes the burdens we bear - discipline, sacrifice, temperence...  Are you prepared for this, Sybil?
lines.zh: 如果你成为正义修女会的一员，你唯一目标就是成为战争的神圣武器，并且使用神质作为你的盔甲和武器。 有了这种力量，也就要肩负我们的职责——纪律、牺牲、节欲…… 准备好了吗，茜比尔？
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: I want nothing more, ma'am...  I am prepared to do whatever it takes!!
lines.zh: 女士，我别无所求…… 我准备好了！！
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en:
Psst... I think you should probably call her "Sister" now...
Psst... I think you should probably call her "Sister" now...

Then from now on, until you depart this world, you are a Paladin.  Serve Donar and the cause of good and justice until your last breath.  I am honored to welcome someone as brave as you, Sister Sybil.
lines.zh: 那么从现在开始，直至死亡，你都是一名圣骑士。 为多纳尔和正义事业奉献一生。 我很荣幸能欢迎像你这样勇敢的人，茜比尔姐妹。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Thank you...  thank you so much...
lines.name: 茜比尔
